in_arabic.name: الستار
in_arabic.meaning: الله کا وہ نام جو اپنے بندوں کی پوشیدہ باتوں کو چھپا لیتا ہے
in_arabic.long_meaning: الستار اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک ایسا نام ہے جو اس کی عظیم صفت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، یعنی وہ اپنے بندوں کی پوشیدہ باتوں کو چھپا لیتا ہے اور ان کی شرمندگیوں کو خفیہ رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام اس کی رحمت اور کرم کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

data.cultural_impact: The name Sattar is derived from the Arabic word "sattar" which means "to cover" or "to conceal". In Islamic history and culture, this name holds significant importance as it is associated with the prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) who had the title 'Al-Sattar' meaning The Veiled One. In an event in the life of Ibrahim, Allah (God) concealed him from his enemies, ensuring his safety and security. This event reflects the deep faith and reliance on Allah for protection and concealment, and the cultural impact of this name is a reminder of the fundamental belief in the power and mercy of Allah in protecting and hiding a believer from harm.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Sattar embodies the idea of protection and concealment provided by Allah. Allah, as the ultimate protector and concealer, reveals only what is good and beneficial for us, while concealing or hiding the hardships and trials that may test our faith. The name Sattar reminds Muslims of the importance of placing their trust in Allah's protection and concealment, and to seek His mercy and guidance in times of difficulty. This name is a source of comfort for believers, assuring them of Allah's endless love and support.
